perks.name: Smallbore
perks.description:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Modified Heatsink
perks.description:
Battery slowly recharges over time when the weapon is stowed or not being fired. 

[Reload]  to vent the core, greatly increasing the speed at which the battery recharges.

perks.name: Amalgamation Rounds
perks.description:
Aiming down sights for a short period without firing compresses the spread into a single high-density projectile. Damaging a target with this shot marks them.

This weapon deals additional damage to marked targets. Defeating a marked target or landing a precision final blow with an Amalgamation Round grants invisibility and truesight.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

catalyst.name: Third Iteration Catalyst
catalyst.description: Precision final blows with Amalgamation Rounds cause the target to detonate into a weakening blast.
